name: code-rubric-mid
description: Balanced code-diagnosis rubric for adaptive assessment.

criteria.description: How correctly the solution satisfies task requirements.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Prioritize objective test pass/fail evidence; confidence should decrease when failures are broad.
quality_checks: Do not claim complete correctness when any required test fails.
Reference concrete failed tests or passed coverage evidence.
Separate algorithm intent from measured behavior.

criteria.description: How robustly the solution handles boundaries and atypical inputs.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Assess explicit guards, empty/singleton handling, and consistency across edge tests.
quality_checks: Cite at least one edge-related signal (test or code path).
Penalize missing input guards where required.
Avoid inferring edge coverage without evidence.

criteria.description: How appropriate and efficient the chosen approach is for the prompt.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Use complexity, data structure choices, and decomposition evidence from code and static signals.
quality_checks: Call out avoidable quadratic patterns when linear alternatives are expected.
Reward correct use of canonical structures/patterns.
Distinguish style issues from algorithmic limitations.

criteria.description: How maintainable and clear the implementation is while honoring the function contract.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Assess readability, side effects, naming clarity, and contract compliance.
quality_checks: Flag contract violations (wrong return shape, mutating inputs unexpectedly).
Reward clear structure and meaningful identifiers.
Avoid purely subjective criticism without code evidence.

mistake_patterns: Invents failed tests or references unknown test IDs.
Provides competency claims outside the allowed competency set.
